projects.name: Atmosphere Free Stack
projects.purpose: Research and planning for a portable, modular, low-cost ATProto PDS and publishing toolkit.
projects.current_direction: Evaluate pds.js first as the PDS engine; keep providers and publishing modules replaceable. Cloudflare is a practical target, not a required provider. Spaces remain disabled in the initial path.
projects.notes: These current documents are planning references. They explicitly do not establish a production PDS, installer, complete recovery, or tested provider portability. Keep the private upstream canonical; review before publishing excerpts or source.
